maya: Preflight note: scheduling live tenant_compat_backfill at 02:30 UTC during quiesce. Staging showed short row lock bursts (8-20s). Opening thread to confirm thresholds and rollback plan.

sam: ack, I'll be on lockwatch. paste the staging snippet?

maya: staging snippet: 2026-03-20 02:13:02 shard-5 PID 4123 waiting row exclusive on tenant_rows (wait=12s)
2026-03-20 02:13:14 shard-5 holder PID 4099

deploybot: Automated: Canary tenant_compat_backfill started (id: cbackfill-2026-03-21-02). Heartbeat every 3m.

leo: Proposed thresholds: if we observe >=4 waits >25s across >=2 shards -> auto-pause, drop batch_size by 50%, enable kv-cache, retry up to 2 times. If any deadlock detected -> immediate stop and rollback.

nora: +1. Also let's pin the backfill runner to v1.12.3 for this run; v1.13 changed its retry backoff.

infra-bot: Alert rule `tenant_backfill_lock_guard` created. Will notify #eng-oncall after first pause event.

oncall-bot: Oncall notified: nora is primary, sam is secondary.

sam: If paused, please also capture deploy snapshot: `deploybot job snapshot <id>` and post to artifacts.

maya: Runbook: 1) Preflight: ensure no outstanding false-held locks. 2) Start canary. 3) On threshold: deploybot auto-pause + adjust batch_size + kv-cache = on, retry 2x. 4) If retries fail or deadlock -> cancel backfill, revert feature flag, rotate traffic pins, open incident.

leo: Add a quick rollback checklist for runbook: list of SQL to revert flag, contact ops lead, and TTL for reschedule window (48h).

nora: I'll publish a one-line release note in release-notes channel after successful canary: "tenant_compat_backfill (runner v1.12.3) running in quiesce window; lock guard active."

maya: Kicking at 02:30 UTC. Will log live updates and paste any snapshots here. :rocket:
